prompts.everyday.shopping.short: Make a shopping list from this menu: [menu]
prompts.everyday.shopping.detailed: Make a shopping list from this [days]-day menu for [how many] people: [menu]. Already at home: [at home]. Group by store section, give approximate quantities, mark what could be swapped for something cheaper. Leave out prices unless you know them for sure.
prompts.everyday.shopping.refine: Cut the list down: the budget is smaller. What can be removed or swapped while staying filling?
prompts.everyday.shopping.check: Have I forgotten anything for [dish]? Here's the recipe: [recipe]
prompts.everyday.dish.detailed: At home I have: [ingredients]. I have a stove and [other appliances]. Time: up to [minutes] minutes. Restrictions: [restrictions]. Suggest 4 dishes: name, which of my ingredients they use, what's missing (and how to manage without it), brief steps.
prompts.everyday.dish.refine: Make dish [number] more filling without buying anything.
prompts.everyday.dish.check: Here are the steps I'm following: [steps]. Have I missed anything important?
prompts.everyday.cleaning.short: Make a cleaning plan by area for [time].
prompts.everyday.cleaning.detailed: Help me plan a clean. Rooms: [rooms]. Time: [time]. Helpers: [who's helping, by role]. Split into areas, and for each: what to do, in what order (top to bottom, dry before wet), how many minutes. Add short breaks. Keep helpers' tasks manageable.
prompts.everyday.cleaning.refine: Make a quick 20-minute version for when guests are arriving soon.
prompts.everyday.cleaning.check: How can I spread the cleaning across the week so it's not all on one day?
prompts.everyday.trip.short: Make a packing list for [destination] for [days] days.
prompts.everyday.trip.detailed: Make a packing list: trip to [destination], [days] days, season [season], transport [transport], purpose: [purpose]. Sections: documents (names only, no numbers), clothes, toiletries, devices and chargers, first-aid kit (general items), small things. Mark what goes in hand luggage.
prompts.everyday.trip.refine: I only have a backpack. What can go, or be replaced with something multipurpose?
prompts.everyday.trip.check: Go through the list with me: ask item by item and I'll answer yes or no.
prompts.everyday.compare.detailed: I'm choosing between: [options]. For: [purpose]. What matters to me: [criteria]. Make a table by my criteria using only the data I've given: [data]. Where there's no data, write “find out”. Finish with which option suits which priority, without a single “right” answer.
prompts.everyday.compare.refine: What questions should I ask the seller to fill the gaps?
prompts.everyday.compare.check: I'm leaning towards [option]. What might I be underestimating?
prompts.everyday.chores.short: Make a weekly chore schedule for [who, by role].
prompts.everyday.chores.detailed: Make a chore schedule. Who's involved: [who, by role and age]. Chores: [chores]. Consider availability: [availability]. Table by day: chore, who, how many minutes. Spread the load roughly evenly, give children age-appropriate tasks. Add a rotation so unpleasant chores take turns.
prompts.everyday.chores.refine: Make a version as a simple checklist for the fridge.
prompts.everyday.chores.check: How many minutes a week does each person get? Is it fair?
prompts.everyday.purchase.short: What should I ask myself before buying [item]?
prompts.everyday.purchase.detailed: I want to buy [item] for about [budget]. Write questions: do I need it now, how often will I use it, is there an alternative (borrow, second-hand, repair the old one), which specs matter, what to ask the seller, which return and warranty terms to check.
prompts.everyday.purchase.refine: Add warning signs that a seller might be dishonest.
prompts.everyday.purchase.check: Here are my answers: [answers]. Is the purchase justified, or should I wait?
prompts.everyday.project.short: Help me plan a small project: [project]
prompts.everyday.project.detailed: I want to do: [project]. I have [time] and about [budget]. Skills: [skills]. Make a plan: what to buy or find, steps in order, how long each takes, where people usually go wrong, when to get help. If it needs a professional, say so plainly.
prompts.everyday.project.refine: Make a simplified version I can finish in one weekend day.
prompts.everyday.project.check: I'm on step [step] and got [result]. What might have gone wrong?
prompts.everyday.instruction.short: Rewrite these instructions as simple steps: [instructions]
prompts.everyday.instruction.detailed: Rewrite the instructions for someone doing this for the first time: numbered steps, one action per step, what should happen after each step, warnings kept separate and not shortened. If something in the original is unclear, flag it rather than guessing. Instructions: [instructions]
prompts.everyday.instruction.refine: Make a version for an older relative: plain words, no technical terms.
prompts.everyday.instruction.check: I'm stuck on step [number]: [what's happening]. What should I do?
prompts.everyday.clarify.short: What should I clarify before deciding: [situation]?
prompts.everyday.clarify.detailed: I need to decide: [situation]. What I know: [what I know]. List what's worth clarifying: facts, terms, deadlines, costs, risks, the views of those affected. For each, who to ask or where to find out. Mark the questions it's too early to decide without.
prompts.everyday.clarify.refine: Turn these questions into a short, polite message for [who, by role].
prompts.everyday.clarify.check: I found out: [answers]. Is that enough to decide?

verify.everyday.shopping: Check the list against what's already at home, and against ingredients if anyone in the family has an allergy.
verify.everyday.dish: Account for allergies and dietary restrictions yourself: the AI only knows what you've told it. Make sure the food is fresh.
verify.everyday.cleaning: Don't mix different cleaning products: some combinations release dangerous fumes. Read the label.
verify.everyday.trip: Check documents, medicines and baggage rules yourself with the carrier's official sources.
verify.everyday.compare: Check prices and specs on the seller's or manufacturer's site: the AI's information may be out of date.
verify.everyday.chores: Discuss the schedule with everyone involved: what seems fair to you may not seem fair to others.
verify.everyday.purchase: Confirm return, warranty and delivery terms with the seller. Check reviews in several places.
verify.everyday.project: For repairs, electrics or work at height, follow the instructions and call a professional if in doubt.
verify.everyday.instruction: Warnings may have dropped out in simplifying. Check every safety point against the original instructions.
verify.everyday.clarify: Get answers from whoever is responsible: the seller, the organiser, the official website.
